snapshot.title: Attachment snapshots: classic build versus L2NX
snapshot.desc: One letter with a +7 sword with Fire 150 attached, received on two servers. Classic build: the attachment is the live item only, so after the receive the letter lists nothing. L2NX: the live item moves to the inventory and the letter keeps the immutable snapshot taken at send, marked as received.
snapshot.subject: A gift for you
snapshot.classic_caption: Attachment = live item: nothing left after receive
snapshot.l2nx_caption: Attachment = snapshot + live item: snapshot stays

transaction.title: Receive persistence: classic build versus L2NX
transaction.desc: Classic build: the receiver and the letter are written separately; a crash between the writes persists the item in both. L2NX: one ACID transaction; a crash before the commit rolls everything back, the retry with the same idempotency key commits once, and a further retry with that key is replayed without executing.
transaction.classic_caption: Two writes, no transaction: a crash in between dupes
transaction.l2nx_caption: One ACID transaction, idempotent by key

race.title: Receive and cancel racing on one letter: conditional update
race.desc: Receive and Cancel on one letter at the same moment. Both are conditional updates WHERE attachments = ATTACHED on the letter row; the receive commits first and the row becomes RECEIVED, the cancel matches no row and is refused with already received.
race.heading: Receive and cancel, concurrent
race.caption: Optimistic concurrency on the row: one commit
